technospheres.name: Agile
technospheres.description:
You treat your Dexterity as if it were one die size higher (up to a maximum of d12).

This hoplosphere occupies 2 slots.

technospheres.name: Arctic
technospheres.description:
You gain Resistance to ice damage. If this item is a weapon, all damage it deals becomes ice.
• Coag. 2: you gain Immunity to ice damage.
• Coag. 3: any ice damage you deal ignores Resistances. When you deal damage, you may change its type to ice.
